title: Resolution urging Albany to pause evictions during extreme weather
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass and the Governor to sign the “Extreme Weather Tenant Protection Act” (A.9033-A/S.8960-A). The bill would pause residential evictions during official National Weather Service excessive heat or cold warnings or declared severe weather emergencies, plus 72 hours after, halting court eviction orders and marshal or sheriff removals during that time. The resolution cites a 2025 city health report finding heat causes over 500 premature deaths yearly in New York City.
